messages:
elaine: Quick heads up — proposing we pin runtime to v2.14 for the llama3-q canary. Seen tokenization/garbled outputs on quantized artifacts, likely kernel shape mismatch.

hugo: When did this start? any logs to look at?

elaine: Started after the SDK QE bump on Tuesday. KV cache layout change plus quantization kernel expecting different flash-attn dims. Small diffs but enough to corrupt outputs on ~12% of canary traffic.

ben: paste the failing trace?

elaine: ```
Input: "Summarize quarterly results..."
Output: "�summr..."
Trace: model_loader: mismatch dims 1024 != 1008 at quant_kernel.cc:412
```

priya: Pin as mitigation makes sense. What's the blast radius if we pin runtime? :thinking_face: 

elaine: Only affects canary shards for llama3-q family. Hosted GPT-like customers unaffected. Pin will be runtime-only (no model rollback).

deploybot: deploy scheduled: apply runtime pin v2.14 -> 2.14 for canary group 'llama3-q-canary' at 2024-06-05T03:00:00Z by elaine

sre-oncall: Rollback plan? how quickly can we revert if we see new failures?

elaine: Rollback is config-only: set runtime pin back to 'auto' + redeploy routing. Estimate ~4m for config rollout + ~3m for traffic shift.

hugo: Who owns release notes? I'll add a short line.

hugo: release-notes draft: "Runtime pin to v2.14 for llama3-q canary to address compatibility with quantized kernel layout. Dedicated/private customers unaffected. Temporary mitigation until runtime kernel alignment."

jamal: Should we open an ENG ticket to fix kernel layout and add regression tests?

elaine: Filed ENG-RUNTIME-2314 — align quantization kernel shape, update unit+integration tests. ETA 2 business days.

priya: Approvers? I'm fine if elaine + hugo approve. Set change window 03:00-03:15 UTC.

deploybot: change window requested 2024-06-05T03:00:00Z-2024-06-05T03:15:00Z. approvers: elaine,hugo,priya. status: accepted

ben: I'll watch logs and perf. If error-rate > 1% or latency > +10% will alert here and in #incidents.

elaine: Applying the pin now and will post final status.

deploybot: runtime pin applied by elaine at 2024-06-05T03:02:34Z to canary group 'llama3-q-canary'. config_id: cfg-rt-pin-20240605-01

hugo: Confirming from logs: traffic stable, no regression observed. :thumbsup:

priya: Adding follow-up to roadmap: remove pin after ENG-RUNTIME-2314 closes and regression suite passes.

jamal: Noted. Will close thread once we unpin and validate.

elaine: Thanks everyone — will update the canary checklist and post a brief note to #incidents if anything changes.
